item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia and Ukraine concluded a U.S.-mediated prisoner swap in Abu Dhabi, but broader peace talks ended without a breakthrough. Ukraine used drones to strike Russia's largest oil refinery deep in Siberia, while Russia killed a Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant worker in a drone strike and hit a Ukrainian drone strike in Russia's Smolensk region that killed two people. Russia reported intercepting 146 drones in the Leningrad region and a drone that wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Qatar reported progress in US-Iran talks after a White House meeting, and France blamed Iran for a cyberattack on refrigeration systems. Italy noted that EU nations have not committed to Red Sea security and the EU faces criticism for inaction. US Republicans blocked efforts to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war. UN peacekeepers were accused of failing to protect civilians before the Abiemnom massacre that killed at least 213 people, prompting Amnesty International to call for investigations. A CityLink Aviation plane crashed near Juba, killing all 14 aboard, and the ICRC reported ongoing sexual violence against civilians. Communal violence disrupted worship in South Sudan, with churches struggling amid the unrest. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Seed insecurity is threatening Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested. The conflict has displaced more than 50,000 people and caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
